description: Adds Material You and AMOLED controls to Piko settings on Android 12 and later. On Android 8–11, it applies a fixed Material You-style theme or an optional AMOLED theme.
name: Theme

options.description: Use a fixed pure-black AMOLED theme instead of the fixed Material You-style theme on Android 8–11. On Android 12 and later, use the AMOLED control in Piko settings.
options.title: Pure-black AMOLED theme for Android 8–11

description: Unlocks developer option by long pressing home icon
name: Unlock developer options

description: Unlocks all options using by employee for debugging
name: Unlock employee options

description: Unlocks 'Plus' subscription benefits that are checked locally. USE IT AT YOUR OWN RISK
name: Unlock Plus benefits

description: Raises how many icons Gboard's toolbar can hold — five on a stock build — to 12, so Flexboard's hotkeys and text action buttons fit alongside Gboard's own. How many actually show stays yours, set by dragging them in Gboard's toolbar settings. Force-stop Gboard afterwards: a cached keyboard view can go on showing the old capacity.
name: Bigger Toolbar

description: Bypass Gboard's own startup signature check without changing other callers.
name: Bypass Gboard Signature

description: For debugging. After a keyboard crash, the error is saved and copied to your clipboard the next time the keyboard starts, so it can be pasted into a bug report. This replaces whatever was on the clipboard. Off by default.
name: Crash reporter (debug)

description: Exposes Google Rambler — Gboard's agentic dictation, which rewrites what you say into composed text — as a choice in Voice settings. It is not switched on for you: the feature uses a Google server, has its own quota and asks for consent, so picking it is left to you.
name: Enable Rambler

description: Turns on two finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: grammar check, and a close control on the chips Gboard offers unprompted. Their flags are delivered per app signature, so resigning the APK means they never arrive and stay off. Both are confirmed working on a device; five other flags were tried and dropped.
name: Hidden Features

description: Rename the package to dev.jz6.com.google.android.inputmethod.latin so the patched build installs alongside the official Gboard instead of replacing it.
name: Install as Gboard Clone

description: Uses Android's haptic primitives for keypresses — the crisp tick the rest of the system uses — instead of a plain buzz. Gboard has the code and disables it with an impossible minimum Android version; this removes that. Devices whose vibrator cannot do primitives are unaffected, because Gboard's own hardware check still runs. Note that it changes what the vibration strength slider means, from milliseconds to intensity.
name: Modern keypress haptics

description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings. Grammar check is the switch, not the feature: the row only exists on a resigned build if Hidden Features is applied too.
name: Suggested Settings

description: Swipe left anywhere on the keyboard to delete the previous word, and swipe right to restore it. Uses Gboard's word-scrub engine; anywhere swipes have a one-word default cap, while deliberate backspace swipes keep Gboard's uncapped behaviour.
name: Swipe Left to Delete

description: Swipe right after deleting to put the words back — the swipe starts on the Delete key, or anywhere when Swipe Left to Delete is also applied. Uses Gboard's own undo, which already records what a delete swipe removed.
name: Swipe Right to Undo

description: Swipe up on the keyboard to undo the last autocorrection: the word you typed comes back, as with Gboard's own undo autocorrect on backspace. It works right after the correction, before you type anything else; otherwise the swipe does nothing. The key you swiped on is not typed.
name: Swipe up to undo autocorrect

description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists. These three share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons and with Toolbar Hotkeys. Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, raises the ceiling from five to twelve; without it, five is all the bar can hold.
name: Text Action Buttons

description: Adds eight configurable hotkey slots to Gboard's toolbar — each commits a text of your choice on tap. A slot appears when its text is set; when cleared it hides at the next toolbar rebuild (rotate, switch IME, or restart — there's no mid-session un-register). Text and icon edits apply on the next keyboard open. The slots share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons: Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, makes room for twelve, but on a stock ceiling of five not all eight fit.
name: Toolbar Hotkeys

description: Forces Gboard to show its own vibration strength slider on every device, rather than deferring to the system haptic settings page, so the strength is adjustable instead of being fixed by whichever rollout the device landed in.
name: Vibration Slider Everywhere

description: Removes sharing identifiers and marketing parameters from open.spotify.com links. Keeps playback timestamps, context, and other parameters.
name: Clean sharing links

description: Hides image and video brand-ad sections on Home and Browse. Does not suppress audio ads, player ads, or upgrade prompts. Experimental.
name: Hide Home and Browse ads

description: Hides image brand-ad cards and embedded ad pages in Now Playing. Does not suppress audio ads or other player overlays. Experimental.
name: Hide player ad cards

description: Hides the Premium navigation tab. Change this in Spicetify settings, then restart Spotify. Does not change your subscription or remove other ads.
name: Hide Premium tab

description: Streams audio from an HTTPS WebDAV folder or Jellyfin music library into Local Files and Your Library. Configure the server in Spicetify settings; playback needs Spotify's Local audio files setting. Experimental; requires byte-range support. Not available for root mount installs.
name: Local files from a server

description: Pick playlists, albums or Liked Songs to pin first on Home, or turn on Show only my pins to hide Spotify's other shortcuts. Pins are saved on this device; restart Spotify after changing them.
name: Pin shortcuts on Home

description: Adds Android versions of Spicetify extensions to the Spicetify Marketplace's Extensions tab, in Spicetify settings, each off until you turn it on. Trash Bin skips the songs and artists you throw away from their menus. Play a random song plays one from all of Spotify or your library, from a Random pill on Home. Shuffle+ plays a playlist, album or Liked Songs in a truly random order when you long-press the shuffle button in Now Playing, choose Shuffle+ this playlist in a playlist's menu, or use its sheet. Hide podcasts hides podcasts and episodes on Home and in Search, and their filters there and in Your Library, and audiobooks unless you turn that off.
name: Spicetify extensions

description: Installable copy of the app under a new package name, with its own label, a recolored and numbered icon, and a corner pill showing the number in-app.
name: Clone with badge

options.description: Package name of the copy. Must differ from the original and from every other copy.
options.title: Package name

options.description: Launcher name of the copy.
options.title: App label

options.description: Number shown in the corner pill and stamped on the icon (1-9).
options.title: Badge number

options.description: Launcher icon background color (#RRGGBB), also used for the digit on the icon.
options.title: Icon color

description: Keeps background playback and its media foreground service alive when the system destroys MusicActivity to reclaim memory. A user-initiated close (back press or swipe from recents) still stops playback.
name: Keep playback on activity destroy

description: Keeps your place in the feed when you come back to Threads within ten minutes, or after any time away with No time limit on. Pull to refresh and a fresh launch still load new posts.
name: Block background-return feed refresh

description: Raises this build's version code to the highest Android allows, so Google Play stops offering Meta's updates over it. Threads' checks against the version it was built as still see the real one. Since every build with this patch has the same code, an older Threads patched with it also installs over a newer one. Once it's in, going back to stock Threads means uninstalling first, which deletes Threads' data on your phone, and later HushThreads builds need this patch too or they won't install over this one.
name: Change version code

description: Redirects matched Pigeon, default event-log and MQTT analytics addresses. Settings show which address kinds were patched. Other telemetry may remain.
name: Disable analytics

description: Threads isn't told when you take a screenshot. It stops looking for new screenshots in your photos and doesn't ask Android to report them.
name: Disable screenshot detection

description: Videos in feed posts don't play by themselves as you scroll. Tap one to watch it full screen.
name: Disable video autoplay

description: Takes sponsored posts out of your Threads feed before they're shown.
name: Hide ads

description: Removes verified server cards suggesting accounts to follow. Ordinary posts, reposts and unknown card types stay.
name: Hide suggested users

description: Adds HushThreads settings to Threads. Tap HushThreads above More settings in Threads' own settings, long-press Threads' launcher icon, or open Additional settings in the app on Threads' App info page, to turn features on or off, pause HushThreads, save your switches to a file or load them, and export diagnostics. The licenses are there too.
name: HushThreads settings

description: Photos load at the largest size Threads has instead of one picked for your screen. They're sharper, and each one is a bigger download.
name: Max image quality

description: Opens the web links you tap in your default browser instead of Threads' own, without Threads' click tracker. Threads, Instagram and other Meta pages still open in Threads.
name: Open links in browser

description: Threads' dark mode uses pure black instead of its dark gray behind your feed, posts and profiles, which looks deeper and saves power on an OLED screen. Menus and sheets keep their own grays.
name: Pure black dark mode

description: Adds "Copy media link" to the post menu: the direct links of the post's photos, videos and GIFs.
name: Add ability to copy media link

description: Skips the reason popup and auto-submits when tapping Not Interested.
name: Auto not interested

description: Saves downloaded photos and videos to a folder of your choice instead of Download/X.
name: Custom download folder

options.description: Relative to shared storage, starting with Download, Pictures, Movies, DCIM or Documents, e.g. Pictures/X or Download/Twitter.
options.title: Folder

description: Hides options from the post menu.
name: Custom share menu

options.description: The post action types to hide, e.g. Follow, AddToList, Mute, Block, Report, Embed, NotInterested.
options.title: Hidden options

description: Shares and copies links with another domain, such as fxtwitter.com, in place of x.com.
name: Custom sharing domain

options.description: The domain shared links point at, without https://.
options.title: Domain

description: Sets the sort replies open with.
name: Customize default reply sorting

description: Hides tabs from the Explore page.
name: Customize explore tabs

options.description: The ids of the tabs to hide, e.g. trending, news, sports, entertainment. The server names them, so they are matched without regard to case, hyphens or underscores.
options.title: Hidden tabs

description: Hides actions from the bar under each post.
name: Customize Inline action Bar items

options.title: Hide views (or dislike, where it replaces views)

description: Hides tabs from the bottom navigation bar. Home always stays.
name: Customize Navigation Bar items

description: Hides tabs from Notifications. At least one tab always stays.
name: Customize notification tabs

description: Hides kinds of suggestion from the search box.
name: Customize search suggestions

description: Hides tabs from search results. At least one tab always stays.
name: Customize search tab items

description: Hides rows from the side bar.
name: Customize side bar items

description: Hides tabs from the top of the home timeline. At least one tab always stays.
name: Customize timeline top bar

options.description: Hides the + tab that pins a new timeline to the top bar.
options.title: Hide the Add tab

description: Adds options to the Morphe settings to delete cached promoted entries or clear cached timelines.
name: Delete from database

description: Blocks analytics requests sent to Instagram and Facebook servers.
name: Disable analytics

description: Opens the home timelines where you left them, instead of at the newest posts.
name: Disable auto timeline scroll on launch

description: Disables screenshot detection in direct messages and stories.
name: Disable screenshot detection

description: Adds ability to download posts, reels, stories and highlights
name: Download media

description: Enables ability to download voice messages
name: Download voice message

description: Adds "Post data" to the post menu: everything the app knows about the post, as text.
name: Enable debug menu for posts

description: Always plays videos at the highest quality the device supports, whatever the connection.
name: Enable force HD videos

description: Holds each post for a few seconds before sending it, so it can be undone.
name: Enable Undo Posts

options.description: Seconds a post waits before it is sent.
options.title: Undo period

description: Adds feed filters to timelines: media only (images, videos, GIFs), hide followed profiles, and include/exclude keyword filtering. Toggle each filter from the Morphe settings.
name: Feed filters

options.description: When set, only posts containing at least one of these are shown. Edit in the app.
options.title: Initial include keywords

description: Hides posts whose text contains any of your keywords, ignoring case. Edit the keywords from "Filtered keywords" in any post's menu, or in the Morphe settings.
name: Filter posts by keyword

options.description: Words or phrases filtered until you edit the list in the app.
options.title: Initial keywords

description: Hides categories of stories from the story tray.
name: Filter stories

options.description: Hides advertisements from the story tray.
options.title: Hide ad stories

options.description: Hides suggested users and creators from the story tray.
options.title: Hide suggested stories

options.description: Hides resurfaced highlights, which carry no expiry, from the story tray.
options.title: Hide highlights

options.description: Hides "Add Yours" / "Your Turn" stories from the story tray.
options.title: Hide "Your Turn" stories

description: Offers to translate every post, not only those the server marks translatable.
name: Force enable translate

description: Opens links to other X frontends, such as fxtwitter and vxtwitter, in the app. They have to be enabled under "Open by default" in the app's system settings.
name: Handle custom twitter links

options.description: Link hosts to open in the app. Subdomains are included.
options.title: Hosts

description: Hides ads in the feed.
name: Hide ads

description: Hides the unread counts and dots on the bottom navigation bar.
name: Hide badges from navigation bar icons

description: Hides the "See new posts" pill at the top of the timeline.
name: Hide Banner

description: Hides Community Notes under posts.
name: Hide Community Notes

description: Hides the floating Post button.
name: Hide FAB

description: Hides Instants from DMs page.
name: Hide Instants

description: Hides the Boost button on your posts and the Boost item in their menu.
name: Hide promote button

description: Hides suggested reels and suggested accounts. Suggested stories are hidden by Filter stories.
name: Hide suggested content

options.description: Hides suggested reels from feed and reels tab.
options.title: Hide suggested reels

options.description: Hides suggested accounts from the list of followers and from other profiles.
options.title: Hide suggested accounts

description: Hides the Threads button from the profile page action bar (top right of the profile page).
name: Hide Threads profile button

description: Overrides the app's feature switches with values chosen when patching.
name: Hook feature flag

options.description: One key=value per entry, e.g. some_feature_enabled=true. true and false set a boolean, whole numbers an integer, other numbers a decimal, and anything else a string.
options.title: Feature switches

description: Adds Export login and Import login to the Morphe settings, opened from the app icon's shortcuts. An export holds everything needed to use your account.
name: Import/Export login token

description: Requests the maximum resolution images from the server.
name: Improve image viewing

description: Shares posts as x.com/<username>/status/<id> rather than x.com/i/status/<id>.
name: Legacy share links

description: Changes unexpired view once, view twice media to permanent view.
name: Make ephemeral media permanent

description: Lets every photo, video and GIF be saved from its long-press menu and the media viewer, without a watermark.
name: Native downloader

description: Adds "Reader mode" to the post menu: the post's text, selectable, with links to its media.
name: Native reader mode

description: Adds "Translate with Google" to the post menu.
name: Native translator

description: Opens links in posts at their real address instead of through t.co.
name: No shortened URL

description: Opens links in the system browser instead of the in-app browser.
name: Open links externally

description: Removes promoted posts, accounts and trends from timelines.
name: Remove Ads

description: Removes Premium upsells: the Upgrade button on the home timeline, the Premium side bar row, and the Get verified cards and prompts.
name: Remove premium upsell

description: Removes the Reddit Pro section from the community drawer, and the Reddit Pro promos: the post creation and subreddit join upsell sheets, and the Reddit Pro banner on the profile feed.
name: Remove Reddit Pro section

description: Removes the Resources and Games on Reddit sections from the community drawer.
name: Remove Resources and Games on Reddit sections

description: Moves Interested and Not Interested to the top of the post menu.
name: Reorder menu options

description: Removes tracking parameters from links shared out of the app.
name: Sanitize share links

description: Keeps a local copy of incoming DMs so ones the sender deletes stay readable. Messages are stored unencrypted in the app's private storage.
name: Save deleted messages

options.description: How long a copy of a message that was not deleted is kept. A message deleted after this is not recoverable. Deleted messages are kept until cleared.
options.title: Days to keep messages

description: Adds "Share as image" to the share sheet of a post, which shares it as an image card.
name: Share Tweet as Image

description: Shows the results of polls without voting. Polls cannot be voted on while this is applied.
name: Show poll results

description: Builds microG Maps, a separate app (org.ungoogled.android.apps.maps.microg) that signs in to your Google account through microG: saved places and lists, Timeline, location sharing, contributions and push messages. Remove sign-in prompts, Trim account menu and Remove permissions are left out of this build, Offline saved places keeps only its Local saved screen, which copies your account's saved lists to the phone (Pull from Google account), and its icon carries microG's C. Needs microG: MicroG-RE or ReVanced GmsCore. Not for root (mount) installs.
name: Add microG support

description: Allows Google Maps, Android Auto, and third-party media controllers to connect to YouTube Music.
name: Allow external media browser connections

dependencies: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility
description: Enables YouTube Music and modded media apps as the navigation mini player.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music mini player

options.description: Package name of your modded YouTube Music app.
options.title: YouTube Music package name

description: Adds package queries and permission to AndroidManifest.xml for full media apps visibility.
name: Allow Morphe YouTube Music package visibility

description: AMOLED-black theme. Pins Maps' own dark mode and its separate navigation colour scheme, and remaps colour resources, drawable fills and draw-time paints so no surface is left grey.
name: Black theme
